inspiration.observed_pattern: A grouped report preserves optional metadata through a LEFT JOIN while projecting a scalar JSON_OBJECT, summing numeric values, and building a keyed JSON_OBJECTAGG map from grouped detail rows.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a project metric report. Projects optionally join owner metadata, metric rows are grouped into a total and a JSON code-to-value map, and the scalar project descriptor retains a JSON null owner for an unassigned project. The source game schema, identifiers, joins, and values are newly authored.

fixture_notes: Project 1201 has one metric and an owner; project 1202 has one metric but no owner, so the LEFT JOIN emits a JSON null owner while the single-key aggregate map and total remain populated. One metric per project removes JSON_OBJECTAGG member-order ambiguity while retaining the grouped map contract.
determinism_notes: Project IDs, owner metadata, metric codes, metric values, JSON keys, grouping columns, and final ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE project_catalog (project_id INT PRIMARY KEY, project_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, project_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE project_owners (owner_id INT PRIMARY KEY, project_id INT NOT NULL, owner_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE project_metrics (metric_id INT PRIMARY KEY, project_id INT NOT NULL, metric_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, metric_value INT NOT NULL)
INSERT INTO project_catalog VALUES (1201, 'NOVA', 'Nova rollout'), (1202, 'ORBIT', 'Orbit migration')

steps.sql: SELECT p.project_id, JSON_OBJECT('code', p.project_code, 'name', p.project_name, 'owner', o.owner_name) AS project_info, SUM(m.metric_value) AS total_metric_value, JSON_OBJECTAGG(m.metric_code, m.metric_value) AS metric_map FROM project_catalog AS p LEFT JOIN project_owners AS o ON o.project_id = p.project_id INNER JOIN project_metrics AS m ON m.project_id = p.project_id GROUP BY p.project_id, p.project_code, p.project_name, o.owner_name ORDER BY p.project_id
